name: tinge
status: development: full Resolve/Lightroom parity is NOT achieved

agent_protocol.finalize_registered_workfiles_to_recycle: Windows local fixed drives; source, history, final drafts and durable exports retained

processing.backend: Rust CPU / Rayon + statically linked OpenColorIO C++
processing.clipping: integer output and documented per-operator domain constraints
processing.cache: in-process, content-addressed, configurable 512MiB per engine default; idle release after 60s; not a process memory limit

implemented: Iridas / Resolve cube LUT: 1D, 3D and combined 1D shaper + 3D; independent ranges; trilinear / tetrahedral interpolation
lut_inspect and pointwise opaque RGB recipe/project-revision baking to standalone 3D cube; explicit input/output encodings and sampled error QA; frozen dependencies before sampling
RGB ICC input conversion and output ICC

RAW decode and revisioned v1 development: pre-demosaic camera WB / xy, full black-white repeat patterns, exposure, crop / orientation, decoder-supplied calibration illuminant selection; raw_plan metadata and sensor probes (rawler support range)
real OCIO 2.5.2, pinned builtin ACES 1.3 / 2.0 configs, camera Log input and sRGB / Display P3 / Rec.2100 PQ display views
revisioned OCIO input/display pipeline, consistent previews, scene-linear float export
custom OCIO config discovery, explicit context defaults/overrides and numeric CPU transforms
native binary OCIOZ project snapshots of config and supported LUT files under its working directory
immutable OCIO package validation before cached decoding; portable project history/context restore
declared linear OCIO anchor primaries and custom display/preview names
ocio_grade graph nodes: native ASC CDL v1.2 and RGB affine matrices in named OCIO process spaces; ordered/inverse/fallback Look strings
OCIO node dependency compilation before project commits and cache hits; processor IDs/context/files/looks in progress and validation reports

ASC cc/ccc/cdl parameter exchange: native OCIO reads, strict UTF-8 XML structure, case-sensitive ID / explicit index selection, f64-preserving export with native reread; immutable inline grades with source hash and standard descriptions; project-revision parameter export reports omitted interpretation/graph context
wide-gamut RGB ICC output and tagged linear EXR with colorInteropID/chromaticities
16-bit Rec.2020 PQ PNG cICP output, selected cICP input, explicit manual PQ luminance scale
EXR premultiplied alpha exchange, custom chromaticities conversion and metadata inspection

weight-free cutout: sampled color key, deterministic 5-component full-covariance GrabCut with rectangle/strokes, explicit trimap or mask, native closed-form alpha matting, grow/feather, local foreground decontamination, despill; transparent PNG/TIFF/EXR and raw scalar 16-bit PNG matte

color_transforms.icc: moxcms RGB profile to linear sRGB; explicit input_space overrides metadata
color_transforms.ocio_image_pipeline: exact builtin config or hashed native OCIOZ project snapshot + engine version; explicit context; managed ICC/RAW or encoded RGB input; declared linear OCIO anchor encoding converted to/from canonical Frame; selected sRGB/P3/PQ display for integer output; explicit SDR preview for P3/PQ; scene values for float output
color_transforms.ocio_snapshot_limits: native archivable configs only; all supported LUT extensions under the working directory; no outside-root relocation; no links/junctions; 100000 directory entries and 512 MiB LUT payload limit
color_transforms.ocio_grade: requires color_pipeline; canonical linear Frame -> declared anchor -> chosen color_space -> native CDL/matrix -> anchor -> canonical; Looks own process spaces; mask/mix after return to canonical; float outputs include grades and omit display view
color_transforms.ocio_cdl: finite nonnegative slope/saturation, positive power; inverse requires positive slope/saturation; style asc or no_clamp (default); inverse ASC cannot recover clipped values
color_transforms.output: linear/sRGB/gamma22/gamma24 RGB ICC for supported primaries in PNG/JPEG/TIFF; linear EXR colorInteropID + chromaticities; Rec.2020 PQ only in 16-bit PNG with cICP
color_transforms.pq_luminance: decoded PQ linear 1 = 10000 nits; manual scene export requires linear_unit_nits; OCIO HDR view owns its scene-to-display mapping
color_transforms.exr_alpha: premultiplied on disk, straight in Frame; zero-alpha additive RGB input rejected; hidden RGB at zero alpha discarded on export with warning

not_implemented: LUT formats beyond cube, 1D/shaper baking, automatic LUT inversion and spatial/alpha-dependent LUT baking
full RAW development parameters / DCP / dual-illuminant calibration / highlight recovery
outside-root OCIO dependency relocation and full config packaging, arbitrary domains for all legacy operators and Resolve RCM equivalence
CMYK/gray ICC, full CICP import, soft proofing and professional display
HLG display OOTF, HDR static/mastering metadata and complete HDR format/profile support
AI Magic Mask / depth / relighting / face tools
Resolve mesh color warper equivalence and ColorSlice
complete Resolve FX / OpenFX host / DCTL
durable daemon jobs and progress/cancel recovery across process restart
all remaining static-image Resolve Studio features
professional calibrated/HDR viewer, GPU tiled previews and packaged Codex plugin bridge

raw_development.levels: native sensor units; full repeat patterns up to 16x16 and interleaved cpp
raw_development.wb_stage: before demosaic; legacy absent settings retain after-demosaic WB
raw_development.missing_as_shot: explicit selected-matrix D65 xy fallback in raw_plan
raw_development.scene_output: linear sRGB D65; no upper sensor clipping / highlight reconstruction
raw_development.camera_corpus: four selected CC0 camera files; limited acceptance, no Lightroom pixel parity

temperature.method: Kang 2002 fit; analytic branch tangent; signed normal offset in CIE 1960 uv
temperature.positive_duv: greener source white; camera WB compensates toward magenta

cutout.runtime: native Rust CPU; no Python/OpenCV runtime

viewer.backend: native Rust loopback HTTP; embedded HTML/CSS/JavaScript; no Node runtime
viewer.startup: view project --port 0; opens default browser, --no-open prints local URL
viewer.preview: ICC-tagged 8-bit SDR sRGB using the same native CLI display pipeline
viewer.selections: separate atomic .selections.json; immutable revision/source/recipe/output-node/dimensions; CLI selections and MCP selection_save
